Job DescriptionFor more than 30 years, Advancis has been developing innovative software solutions for security and building automation. As one of the international market leaders, our solutions are used worldwide in businesses, critical infrastructures, and complex building environments.

As a System Administrator (m/f/d), you administer systems with a strong focus on security and take a holistic approach, from network design to selecting the right tools. IT security is an integral part of your mindset, including concepts such as Zero Trust, network segmentation, and SIEM. We are currently building our Information Security Management System (ISMS) and preparing for ISO/IEC 27001 certification. This means that systems are not only operated but are also assessed based on risk and documented in a transparent and traceable manner. Experience with ISO 27001 is an advantage but not a requirement. However, a willingness to think and work within this framework is essential.
Why us?
• Modern and attractive working environment
• Open and dynamic company culture
• Exciting tasks within a highly motivated team
• Diverse career development opportunities, including support for professional and personal growth
• Attractive compensation package with participation in the company's success
• Flexible working hours
• Company health insurance and retirement benefits
• Benefits such as fitness programs, massage, yoga, JobRad bicycle leasing, or public transport ticket
• Centrally located office with excellent public transport connections, as well as ample parking and EV charging facilities
• Regular company events

Your mission
• Planning and implementation of IT projects, particularly in the areas of infrastructure and networking
• Operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the existing IT environment
• Ensuring IT security, including vulnerability and risk management (e.g., IAM, network segmentation, incident response)
• Identifying and implementing automation opportunities within daily operations
• Providing support in day-to-day IT operations (endpoint management, employee lifecycle processes, user support)
• Technical consulting and support for business departments and international locations

Your profile
• Several years of experience in IT systems administration and the implementation of IT projects
• Very good knowledge of hybrid Microsoft 365 environments (Entra ID, Exchange Online, Office Suite)
• Solid experience with Microsoft Windows Server and client systems, as well as hyperconverged virtualization platforms (Hyper-V)
• Good knowledge of network architecture, modern networking technologies, storage solutions (on-premises and cloud), as well as backup and recovery management
• Basic knowledge of VoIP PBX systems, Linux including Docker, and application administration
• Independent, efficient, and structured way of working, combined with excellent communication skills
• Understanding of risk-based decision-making, with the ability to balance and justify technical decisions against security requirements, operational feasibility, and cost-efficiency
• Knowledge of information security management and initial exposure to ISO/IEC 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, or similar frameworks is desirable but not required
• Ability to document complex technical matters in a clear and traceable way, from operational documentation to configuration and change records that stand up to audit requirements

About usAt Advancis, people are at the heart of everything we do. Our success is built on the ideas, expertise and commitment of our employees. That's why we foster a work environment based on trust, teamwork and mutual respect.

We provide the freedom to bring in new ideas, take ownership and grow both professionally and personally. Short decision-making processes, modern working conditions and an open company culture enable everyone to make a real impact.

We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We believe the best ideas emerge when different perspectives come together.

One Advancis. Shaping the future together.

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities 

Briese Chartering is an established Shipowner/Carrier based in Leer/Germany managing a modern and versatile fleet of short-sea and multipurpose (MPP) vessels ranging from 3,000 to 10,000 DWT with a strong focus on carriage of project cargo. For further information see: www.briese-chartering.com (http://www.briese-chartering.com/)   

We are seeking an experienced Chartering Broker to join our Intra-Europe Regional Trade desk. In this role you will hold commercial responsibility for maximizing the utilization and profitability of our owned and controlled tonnage. You will optimize vessel loops across Europe, securing high-yielding regional breakbulk and specialized project cargo stems by maintaining direct relationships with industrial charterers, shippers and project forwarders.

Negotiate charter parties directly with cargo owners and competitive brokers, protecting the company's commercial interests. 

Fleet Optimization & Chartering 

Fix our 3,000–10,000 DWT fleet on Voyage Charters and Contracts of Affreightment (COAs) across European trade routes (Baltic, North Sea, Continent, Mediterranean/Black Sea and North/West Africa). 

Optimize vessel routing and scheduling to minimize ballast days and maximize daily time charter equivalent returns.

Project Cargo & Voyage Estimation 

Evaluate and price specialized project cargo inquiries tailored to our vessels' capabilities. 

Perform precise voyage calculations including bunker tracking, port/terminal expenses, and laytime analysis to ensure optimal margins. 

Market Integration & Collaboration 

Leverage the north/central European shipping community while managing an active network of international chartering contacts. 

Work closely with our in-house operations and technical management teams in Leer to guarantee smooth post-fixture execution. 

Qualifications & Experience 

 Essential Criteria 

- Minimum 3 years of commercial experience on the owner’s side or with an exclusive broker specifically within the European short-sea or small-MPP sectors. 
- Solid understanding of 3k–10k DWT vessel capabilities including stowage configurations, deck strength and regional port/canal restrictions. 
- Deep knowledge of European trades including seasonal weather factors, ice clauses and short-sea port operations. 
- Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German is highly preferred given our regional hub and team integration. 

Core Skills 

- Commercial drive with a clear focus on asset P&L and strategic fleet positioning. 
- Proficiency in voyage estimation and other standard software tools (MS Office, Sedna, Netpas, etc.). 
- Existing network of direct project cargo clients, industrial shippers and European forwarders.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis Student in the field of Aerospace Engineering (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airframe Architecture Department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master Thesis Student in the field of Aerospace Engineering (d/f/m), title of thesis: “Preliminary Structure Design of an Amphibious Firefighter Aircraft”

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of Airbus? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Airframe Architecture Department as a Master Thesis Student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.12.2026
- Duration: 6 months

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.
- You will have an experienced tutor to support you.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Develop the preliminary structure design of a new generation amphibious firefighter aircraft focusing on the wing to fuselage attachment.
- Investigate the panorama of existing similar aircraft to understand the different technical solutions in order to define the best structural design principles
- Perform trade offs among different structural solutions applying a Design to Value approach
- You will create an Airframe Architecture Dossier, a document showing the selection of design solutions and their rationale
- You will focus on the Structural Architecture selecting the best concept for your component
- You will focus on the airframe and you will define its architectural principles
- You will minimize cost and weight, maximise manufacturability ensuring that the aircraft can be repaired quickly.
- You will develop 3D CATIA models of the Aircraft and preliminary sizing of some relevant joints.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Aerospace Engineering with focus on Aeronautical Structures (light weight) - up to five years engineering course (end of Master study)
- Fluent in English is a must, German and French is a plus
- You are able to use CATIA 5 (nice to have)
- Ability to perform preliminary sizing of loaded structures (nice to have)
- You have good skills to use OFFICE tools (Word, Excel, Powerpoint) or Google based Tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
- You are a team player and a motivated master student to collaborate with

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Scientific Coordinator (m/f/d) International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging & Stru (Projektkoordinator/in (kaufmännisch))
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Society is one of the world’s leading research organizations. Its institutes conduct cutting-edge basic research in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences and humanities for the benefit of society. Located in Science City Hamburg Bahrenfeld, the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) investigates the properties and dynamics of matter on the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motion. Its interdisciplinary research combines experimental and theoretical approaches, with a particular focus on ultrafast phenomena, quantum materials and advanced imaging methods. The International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging & Structural Dynamics (IMPRS-UFAST) is a joint initiative of the MPSD, Universität Hamburg, Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron (DESY) and European XFEL. It provides outstanding doctoral researchers from around the world with a structured and interdisciplinary training environment at the Hamburg-Bahrenfeld research campus.

To coordinate and further develop this international doctoral program, the MPSD is seeking a highly motivated

Scientific Coordinator (m/f/d) International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging & Structural Dynamics (IMPRS-UFAST)

The position offers an excellent opportunity to apply academic experience and transferable skills in a new professional context and to develop a career in science management. We are looking for a candidate who understands the opportunities and challenges of doctoral research from personal experience and is motivated to use this knowledge to support and further develop the next generation of international researchers.

Your position

- Training Programme - Develop and coordinate a semester-based curriculum of scientific courses and transferable-skills training in close collaboration with IMPRS Fellows and Principal Investigators.
- Plan and organize workshops, retreats, networking events and career-development activities tailored to the needs of doctoral researchers.
- Regularly evaluate and further develop the training program to foster interdisciplinary exchange and professional development.
- Annual International Doctoral Recruitment - Coordinate the annual international recruitment and application process, from developing and publishing doctoral projects and launching the call for applications to organizing the selection symposium, conducting interviews and coordinating final admissions.
- Doctoral Mentoring and Career Development - Support doctoral researchers throughout their time in the programme, from admission and onboarding through to completion, serving as a trusted contact for programme-related, administrative and career matters.
- Develop and coordinate initiatives that help doctoral researchers explore and prepare for career opportunities beyond the PhD.
- IMPRS-UFAST Office and Programme Administration - Oversee the day-to-day operations of the IMPRS-UFAST Office and coordinate communication, collaboration and networking among doctoral researchers, academic partners and committees, national and international partner institutions, and the MPSD administration.
- Serve as a member of the IMPRS-UFAST Executive Board and contribute to programme governance by preparing and coordinating meetings, implementing decisions, and overseeing reports, evaluations and programme documentation.
- Coordinate the programme budget and oversee the website, guidelines, application information, records and communication channels, while contributing to quality assurance, alumni relations, academic networking and the strategic development of IMPRS-UFAST.

Your background and skills

- A completed doctorate in the natural sciences; postdoctoral experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.
- A strong understanding of doctoral research, the challenges and opportunities of an academic career, and the German higher-education and research environment.
- A genuine interest in science management and in applying your academic experience and expertise in a broader professional context.
- Strong communication, coordination and project-management skills, demonstrated through experience in research, teaching, mentoring, event organisation or collaborative projects.
- A proactive, independent and structured approach to work, combined with creativity, initiative and a strong ability to work collaboratively.
- Excellent written and spoken English; very good German language skills or a willingness to develop them further are desirable.
- Intercultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with doctoral researchers, senior scientists, administrative colleagues and external partners.

- Previous experience in science management is an advantage, but not a requirement. We particularly welcome candidates with an academic background who are ready to broaden their professional perspective and bring their scientific expertise, international experience and organisational strengths into a new professional context.

Our offer

- A varied and rewarding role at the intersection of science, doctoral education, career development and science management, with scope for initiative, professional growth and the opportunity to contribute your own ideas to the further development of IMPRS-UFAST.
- An international, interdisciplinary and collegial working environment at the Science City Hamburg Bahrenfeld research campus, with a modern workplace and opportunities for collaboration across institutions.
- A wide range of training and professional-development opportunities.
- A family-friendly working environment and active support in balancing work, family and personal life.
- A subsidy for the Profiticket as a Germany ticket.
- Attractive remuneration and social benefits in accordance with the German public pay scale (TVöD Bund), depending on qualifications and professional experience.
- Supplementary pension provision through VBL.
- An initial contract for two years, with the possibility of permanent employment thereafter.

- The Max Planck Society is committed to gender equality, diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. The Max Planck Society also aims to increase the number of employees with disabilities and therefore expressly encourages applications from qualified individuals with disabilities.

Your application

Please submit the following documents through our online application portal by 26 October 2026.

- a letter of motivation outlining your interest in science management, doctoral training and the development of IMPRS-UFAST
- your curriculum vitae
- copies of your relevant university degrees and doctoral certificate
- relevant employment certificates or references
- a publication list, if applicable

For questions regarding the position, please contact Dr. Neda Lotfiomran (neda.lotfiomran@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:neda.lotfiomran@mpsd.mpg.de) ) . Detailed information about the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter can be found at http://www.mpsd.mpg.de (http://www.mpsd.mpg.de/) .

We look forward to your application.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus:

Integration of quantum-based algorithms into classical computing environments, and system-levelstability/error analysis of the integrated hybrid stack.

The role goes beyond merely operating existing quantum software stacks. It also involves designing modular,hardware-agnostic backends capable of seamlessly integrating both simulators and current NISQ devices. Thisrequires:

Running simulations on HPC systems, including efficiently parallelizing computational tasks

Writing HPC-executable, production-ready code

Ensuring scalability and robustness of algorithms in large-scale environments

Identifying and resolving error sources in the integrated hybrid stack, particularly cascading errors acrossmodules

Developing independent code for simulations, extending beyond the use of standard software libraries

Requirements

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Good knowledge of diverse quantum hardware, error correction/mitigation strategies, and respective SDKecosystems (Qiskit, Cirq, Braket, Qrisp, AutoQML, etc.)

Advanced linear algebra knowledge: matrix diagonalization methods, magnus expansion, Zassenhausformula, group theory

Advanced quantum physics knowledge: quantum circuit design, Trotterization, quantum machine learning, etc

Demonstrated experience running simulations on HPC systems

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

Hands-on experience with multiple quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, Amazon Braket, PennyLane)

Experience implementing or working with quantum error mitigation/correction techniques

Experience running large-scale quantum simulations on HPC clusters (e.g., GPU-accelerated state-vector ortensor-network simulators)

Contributions to open-source quantum computing libraries, or published work on quantum algorithms

Familiarity with ion-trap or other NISQ hardware platforms

Knowledge in writing bash scripts for HPC job submission

German B2 or higher

A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry

An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center

jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role:

Microbiological contamination control is at the heart of pharmaceutical manufacturing quality — and in this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding a cutting-edge portfolio of microbiological testing and automation solutions across key German markets. You will take full ownership of a defined territory, developing and executing a strategic account plan that targets new customer acquisition, deepens existing relationships, and positions the portfolio as the partner of choice within the pharmaceutical and biotech sector.

You will engage consultatively with technical and commercial stakeholders across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, guiding them through high-value capital investment decisions with clarity and credibility. By combining deep microbiological expertise with a structured approach to pipeline management, you will identify untapped market opportunities, introduce advanced automation and robotics solutions, and deliver measurable revenue growth. Your ability to navigate long sales cycles and translate technical value into business outcomes will be central to your success in this role.

Who you are:

- You bring at least 5 years of field sales experience in pharmaceutical quality control, production, or a closely related life science sector, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding commercial targets in complex business-to-business environments.
- You hold academic degree in microbiology, biology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience); knowledge of laboratory automation or robotics is a strong advantage.
- You have in-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical quality control and production environments, including familiarity with Good Manufacturing Practice guidelines, Annex 1 and cleanroom or aseptic processing requirements.
- You are experienced in managing high-value, long-cycle capital expenditure sales processes, including stakeholder mapping across complex organizational structures and engagement at management level.
- You are fluent in German (C2) and English (C1); an established professional network within the German pharmaceutical or life sciences industry is highly advantageous.
- You hold a valid driver’s license and are willing to spend the majority of your working time in the field across Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, and North Rhine-Westphalia; candidates based within these regions are preferred.
- You demonstrate strong negotiation and communication skills, with the confidence to engage credibly across both technical and commercial functions.
- You have a proven ability to manage territory, spending over 70% of time in the field, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and you are highly self-directed and results-oriented, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management and territory planning.
- You are familiar with artificial intelligence concepts and tools, including their practical applications and limitations, and are able to apply this understanding to evaluate and use AI-supported solutions responsibly in a commercial context.

Location

Germany (Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, North Rhine-Westphalia) | Field-based with regional travel

We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Job Description

About Us

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue exceeding $40 billion. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, improving patient diagnostics and therapies or increasing productivity in their laboratories, we are here to support them.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 125,000 extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. It’s a chance to realize your best – professionally and personally.

The job

Are you passionate about applying your chemistry expertise to solve real-world challenges? This 18-month fixed-term role is ideal for scientists who enjoy combining technical problem-solving with meaningful customer interaction.

As a Technical Application Scientist II, you will partner with researchers and customers to resolve complex chemistry-related questions that directly impact their success and the effective use of Thermo Fisher Scientific products. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, while continuously expanding your technical knowledge across a diverse chemical product portfolio.

Continuous learning is central to this role. You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, stay current with new technologies and applications, and contribute to a collaborative, international team that values innovation, inclusion, and professional growth.

Discover what Mai, a Technical Application Scientist, finds fulfilling about this role: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z4aV8NnZxwY&feature=youtu.be (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z4aV8NnZxwY&feature=youtu.be)

What will you do

- Provide expert-level technical support for Thermo Fisher Scientific chemical product portfolios by addressing customer inquiries via telephone, email, and web chat.
- Own and manage technical cases from initial inquiry through resolution, ensuring timely, high-quality customer support.
- Collaborate with internal teams including Quality Assurance and Product Management to resolve complex technical issues and identify effective solutions.
- Maintain accurate and detailed records of customer interactions within CRM systems to support service excellence and continuous improvement.
- Proactively recommend enhancements to technical knowledge bases, websites, processes and other company-managed resources to improve usability and customer experience.
- Invest in your professional development through ongoing product training, continuous learning, and exposure to new applications and emerging technologies.
- Participate in cross-functional projects and special initiatives to broaden technical expertise and career development opportunities.

Education and competencies required

- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
